news.title: Manifesto unveiling and campaign council inauguration
news.body: The Rescue Mission manifesto was unveiled on November 18 alongside the inauguration of the 310-member campaign council, according to Independent Nigeria.

news.title: NDC town hall meeting
news.body: Ohaa addressed the NDC town hall alongside the party’s national campaign. The precise LGA is not assigned until the final venue is verified.

milestones.title: Market traders recovery committee
milestones.body: Establish an independent committee to investigate demolitions and document traders’ losses.

milestones.title: Preliminary market recovery report
milestones.body: The committee submits its preliminary report on affected traders and unresolved claims.

milestones.title: Judicial financial review
milestones.body: Audit judicial allocations, accounts, payroll and outstanding arrears.

milestones.title: Compensation assessment
milestones.body: Commence independent assessment of legitimate market compensation claims.

milestones.title: Replacement trading spaces
milestones.body: Identify available commercial spaces, provide temporary stalls and prioritise verified displaced traders for replacement shops.

milestones.title: Business relief and land review
milestones.body: Review unjustified and duplicative levies; establish a land and housing review committee and open a public consultation channel.

milestones.title: Land administration reforms
milestones.body: Publish findings, release a revised schedule of approved land fees and commence digitisation of priority records.

milestones.title: Solar-for-Water programme
milestones.body: Programme for sustainable pipe-borne supply with solar pumping, distribution and storage improvements.

milestones.title: One ward, one water scheme
milestones.body: Target a functional solar-powered water scheme in every ward.

compact: Direct funding to councils
Implement local government autonomy so allocations reach councils directly.
One ward, one water scheme
Functional solar-powered water schemes in each of the 260 wards by the end of year three.
One ward, one working clinic
Upgrade at least one primary health centre in each ward to 24-hour service.
Farm-to-market roads
Durable rural roads and bridges linking farms, hubs and markets.
Agro-hub in every LGA
Processing, storage and cold-chain hubs for rural employment.
Rural power
Mini-grids and solar systems for communities, hubs, markets and clinics.
Rural security
Community security network and forest guards, early warning and rapid response.
Rural schools and teachers
Rehabilitate schools and pay a rural allowance to teachers and health workers.
Markets, credit and cooperatives
Rebuild rural markets and channel credit through cooperatives and faith-based groups.
Land protection
Due process, valuation, public hearings and prompt compensation for land acquisition.
